name: epoll_create1
description: epoll_create1 creates a new epoll instance and returns a file descriptor. It behaves like epoll_create but without the obsolete size argument, and allows flags to modify behavior, such as setting EPOLL_CLOEXEC for close-on-exec.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags to modify behavior; 0 for default, or EPOLL_CLOEXEC to set close-on-exec on the file descriptor

return_value.success: Returns a file descriptor (a nonnegative integer)
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: The per-process limit on the number of open file descriptors has been reached
The system-wide limit on the total number of open files has been reached
There was insufficient memory to create the kernel object
